intentions.title: Ship Hundesteder, a Norwegian editorial guide to dog-friendly places (cafes, parks, beaches, sights)
intentions.evidence: site-footer.tsx tagline 'En redaksjonell guide til hundevennlige steder i Norge'; site-header.tsx brand 'Hundesteder'; place-card.tsx links to /sted/<slug> detail pages

intentions.title: Let visitors browse places by city and category with live-filtered chip controls and a results count
intentions.evidence: places-browser.tsx: client component deriving sorted city/category facets from the place list, chip toggles with aria-pressed, aria-live results-meta text, and an empty-state message when filters yield nothing

intentions.title: Provide a zero-dependency slippy map of place pins as a first-class alternative to the list/grid browse view
intentions.evidence: places-map.tsx: hand-rolled Web-Mercator projection, Canvas2D tile/pin/label rendering, pointer-driven pan/zoom/hit-testing, popover with detail-page + OSM-directions links, zoom/fit controls, OSM attribution

intentions.title: Map surface must never degrade to a blank box even with tiles disabled or blocked — pins always render over a calm fallback graticule
intentions.evidence: places-map.tsx comment 'the surface never collapses to a blank box'; TILES_ENABLED env flag (NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_TILES) branches between drawTiles and drawGraticule; tile load errors self-evict from cache after 5s instead of blocking

intentions.title: House rule: no npm map libraries and no build-time tile bundling — maps stay vanilla Canvas2D with only an optional runtime tile fetch
intentions.evidence: places-map.tsx top comment: 'House rules kept verbatim: vanilla Canvas2D, ZERO npm map libs (no Leaflet / Mapbox / MapLibre), ZERO build-time tile bundle'; adapted from web/components/listings-map.tsx but stripped of the finder↔map bridge this app doesn't have

intentions.title: Give each place a scannable card identity (category icon/label, city, price range, teaser) that drives into its own detail route
intentions.evidence: place-card.tsx renders category icon via iconPath/categoryLabel from lib/categories, optional city/description/priceRange, and links to /sted/<slug>; used by places-browser.tsx's card-grid
